title: Cloud Controller 2.5.0
summary: Language icon, maximized conversation and a clearer Support screen text.

items.title: Language icon
items.body: The top bar has a language icon with the available languages. The choice applies at once and is remembered for your user.

items.title: Maximize the conversation
items.body: A button on the conversation panel shows it as a large window in the center of the screen. Escape or a click outside closes it.

items.title: Conversation opens at the newest message
items.body: When a ticket opens, or a message arrives, the conversation scrolls to the last message.

items.title: Support screen text
items.body: The text explains the three levels: level 1 is handled by your reseller or distributor with the help of Nexwall's support AI; level 2 is advanced CLI diagnostics on the firewall, with AI analysis and your reseller's or distributor's team; level 3 is the Nexwall team. Everything stays in the same ticket.
